ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows an infinitely repeating ladder impedance network. The left input terminal is labeled Z_eq, and the upper input terminal is first connected in series with an inductive impedance j9 Ω to the first node; from this node downward there is a branch, in which j5 Ω and -j1 Ω are connected in series and then connected to the bottom common rail. This node continues to the right with another j9 Ω in series, and at the next node the same downward branch with j5 Ω and -j1 Ω in series is repeated; on the right, dashed lines and ellipses indicate that this structure extends infinitely. Reasoning: Let the equivalent impedance seen from the original input terminal be Z. The impedance of each vertical branch is j5 + (-j1) = j4 Ω. Since the circuit repeats infinitely to the right, the equivalent impedance seen after passing through the next j9 Ω from the first node and looking in is still Z. Therefore, the equivalent impedance after the first j9 Ω is the parallel connection of j4 and Z, so Z = j9 + (j4 || Z). Let Z = jx; then the parallel term is j4 || jx = j(4x/(4+x)), so x = 9 + 4x/(4+x). Rearranging gives x(4+x)=9(4+x)+4x, that is, x^2 - 9x - 36 = 0. Solving gives x = 12 or x = -3. Taking the stable finite limit of the infinite ladder network, x = 12, therefore Z_eq = j12 Ω.

raw_record.question_text: What is the equivalent impedance \(Z_{eq}\) for the infinite ladder circuit shown in the figure?

method.method_draft: First describe the image structure: an input pair of terminals feeds a top series inductor labeled j9 ohm, then a node with a shunt branch labeled j5 ohm in series with -j1 ohm to the bottom rail, and this same j9-plus-shunt pattern repeats indefinitely to the right. Let Z be the equivalent impedance seen at the original input. The shunt branch at the first node is j5 + (-j1) = j4 ohm. By self-similarity, the impedance looking to the right from that node through the next j9 element and the remaining infinite ladder is again Z. Therefore the impedance after the first j9 is the parallel combination j4 || Z, so set Z = j9 + (j4 || Z). Substitute Z = jx: x = 9 + 4x/(4+x). Solve x(4+x)=9(4+x)+4x, giving x^2 - 9x - 36 = 0, so x = 12 or x = -3. Select x=12 as the stable finite-ladder limit, hence Z_eq = j12 ohm.

图像描述：附图显示一个无限重复的梯形阻抗网络。左侧输入端标注为 Z_eq，上方输入端先串联一个电感阻抗 j9 Ω 到第一个节点；从该节点向下有一条支路，支路中 j5 Ω 与 -j1 Ω 串联后接到底部公共导轨。该节点继续向右又串联一个 j9 Ω，并在下一个节点重复同样的 j5 Ω 与 -j1 Ω 串联下接支路，右侧用虚线和省略号表示这种结构无限延伸。

推理：令从原始输入端看到的等效阻抗为 Z。每个竖直支路的阻抗为 j5 + (-j1) = j4 Ω。由于电路向右无限重复，从第一个节点继续向右经过下一个 j9 Ω 再看进去的等效阻抗仍为 Z。因此，第一个 j9 Ω 后面的等效阻抗是 j4 与 Z 的并联，所以 Z = j9 + (j4 || Z)。设 Z = jx，则并联项为 j4 || jx = j(4x/(4+x))，于是 x = 9 + 4x/(4+x)。整理得 x(4+x)=9(4+x)+4x，即 x^2 - 9x - 36 = 0。解得 x = 12 或 x = -3。取无限梯形网络的稳定有限极限 x = 12，因此 Z_eq = j12 Ω。
